about: Known cases for Full Reference Search: each must give the expected result. Run with [Run Tests] on the page, or: php do_full_reference_search.php _ '{"task": "run_tests"}'. Add a case whenever a problem is fixed. 'requires': skipped when that option is off.

cases.full_reference: "Lackey, James B., and Elsie W. Lackey. ""Microscopic algae and protozoa in the waters near Plymouth in August 1962."" Journal of the Marine Biological Association of the United Kingdom 43, no. 3 (1963): 797-805."
cases.why: Chicago: '"Title." Journal 43, no. 3 (1963): 797-805.' Was read as volume 3, issue 1963; and the year 1962 was taken from the title ('in August 1962').

cases.full_reference: "Lebour, Marie V. ""The Peridiniales of Plymouth Sound from the region beyond the breakwater."" Journal of the Marine Biological Association of the United Kingdom 11.2 (1917): 183-200."
"Lackey JB, Lackey EW. Microscopic algae and protozoa in the waters near Plymouth in August 1962. Journal of the Marine Biological Association of the United Kingdom. 1963 Nov"
cases.why: Vancouver as Google Scholar makes it: no volume or pages ('Journal. 1963 Nov'), so at most 'possible', by the first author, the title and the journal. The year is the one before the month, not 1962 from the title.

cases.full_reference: "Gotsis-Skretas, Olympia;†Pagou, Kalliopi†(2008):†Microplankton abundance in the euphotic zone of the Aegean Sea in October-November 1991.†Hellenic Center of Marine Research, Institut of Oceanography, Greece, doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.692046"

cases.full_reference: "Gotsis-Skretas, O., Pagou, K., & Ignatiades, L. (2008). Microplankton abundance in the euphotic zone of the Aegean Sea in winter 1995."
cases.why: A PANGAEA dataset (in DataCite, not CrossRef), found by the second search. Not its GBIF copy (10.15468/z3e4wd, named in the note), nor its near-twins ('... in September 1994', '... at Station JUNE-9').

cases.full_reference: "Gotsis-Skretas O, Pagou K, Ignatiades L. Microplankton abundance in the euphotic zone of the Aegean Sea in winter 1995."
cases.why: The same dataset with no year but the one in its title ('winter 1995'): DataCite's year is 2008, allowed because the cited year is in its title.
